summary: All requested review items VERIFIED end-to-end (both backend & frontend). Backend: 17/17 tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_pull_conflicts_trash.py covering (a) POST /api/sync/pull-now for user (200, {success,applied,last_pull_at}), admin (200), unauth (401/403); (b) GET /api/admin/conflicts admin 200 list, user 403, unauth 401/403; (c) POST /api/admin/conflicts/{id}/resolve: unknown id -> 404, bad choice -> 400, user -> 403, seeded keep_local resolves with version=max(l,r)+1 & keeps local customer_name, seeded keep_online overwrites local with remote_snapshot and marks resolved+resolution; (d) trash e2e — POST /api/customers -> DELETE -> shows in /api/admin/trash/customer -> restore -> visible again -> delete+purge -> GET returns 404; (e) 20s soft-delete durability — customer stays in Trash after manual pull-now + 20s background pull cycle, does not resurrect; (f) /api/sync/status shape+enum for admin & user, 401 unauth. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport, live public URL): USER login -> Dashboard renders SyncBar (testID sync-bar) with icon+status label 'Sinkron Gagal' + 'Terakhir: baru saja' + Sync Sekarang button (testID sync-now-button) — tapping it calls pull-now and refreshes label without page reload (SYNC_NOW_OK). ADMIN /admin/trash renders WITHOUT any red 'Something went wrong' screen; all 5 tabs (customer, purchasing_size, segment, area, top) present as testIDs and switching tabs works; empty state 'Trash kosong' renders correctly. /admin/master-data also renders cleanly (both files use CircleIcon as Circle from phosphor-react-native — the fix). /admin/conflicts renders empty state 'Tidak ada konflik' as expected. Admin drawer has 'Sync Conflicts' entry (testID admin-drawer-conflicts visible). No pageerrors captured. Pre-existing RN Web deprecation warnings (shadow*/pointerEvents) remain — non-blocking, informational only. The 'Sinkron Gagal' badge on user dashboard is legitimate live state per iteration_5 context (upstream Supabase 'areas' table missing) — NOT a regression.

action_items: None blocking. Optional cleanup: migrate shadow* -> boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web warnings.

Informational (not a bug): user dashboard SyncBar shows 'Sinkron Gagal' because queued area-master push is rejected upstream ('tabel tidak ditemukan'). Once Supabase 'areas' table is provisioned this returns to 'Tersinkron'.
critical_code_review_comments: Trash crash root cause correctly fixed in both /app/frontend/app/admin/trash.tsx:5 and /app/frontend/app/admin/master-data.tsx:16 by importing 'CircleIcon as Circle' from phosphor-react-native (v3.0.6 shipped the alias only for CircleIcon, not Circle).
_log_conflict is idempotent per (entity_type, entity_id) while unresolved (upsert with resolved:false in filter) — no duplicate rows will pile up.
resolve_conflict correctly bumps version to max(local_version, remote_version)+1, re-enqueues to sync_engine, and drops any stale sync_queue rows for the same entity — converges cleanly.
sync_pull_now returns {success, applied, last_pull_at}; last_pull_at flows through app_settings and is picked up by the SyncBar via /api/sync/status.
Frontend SyncBar (src/components/SyncBar.tsx) uses react-query with refetchInterval:8000 and invalidates ['sync-status','dashboard','customers'] on pull success — good, no manual reload needed.
seed_data_creation: Seeded synthetic sync_conflicts + customer docs directly in Mongo (TEST_CONFLICT_*/TEST-*) via pymongo — cleaned up in the same test's finally block. Trash e2e tests create+purge their own TEST-<uuid> customer.

rca_of_issue: iteration_5 Trash crash ('Element type is invalid ... CellRenderer') was caused by 'Circle' being undefined in phosphor-react-native 3.0.6 which only exports 'CircleIcon' under that legacy name. The FlatList row renderer in trash.tsx tried to render <Circle/> (undefined) inside CellRenderer, throwing on first render. Fix (verified): both trash.tsx:5 and master-data.tsx:16 now import { CircleIcon as Circle } from 'phosphor-react-native'. Verified via Playwright: /admin/trash renders WITHOUT 'Something went wrong', all 5 tabs render, tab switching works; /admin/master-data also renders. No pageerrors observed during navigation.
